endsInMonthsMin.title: Ends in at least (months)
endsInMonthsMin.description: Only contracts whose current period of performance ends at least this many months from today. Use 0 to include contracts ending now.

endsInMonthsMax.title: Ends in at most (months)
endsInMonthsMax.description: Only contracts whose current period of performance ends at most this many months from today.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: NAICS codes to include, e.g. 541512 (Computer Systems Design Services). 2- or 4-digit prefixes are accepted. Leave empty for all industries.

pscCodes.title: PSC codes
pscCodes.description: Product/Service Codes to include, e.g. DA01 or R425.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against award descriptions and other fields.

awardTypes.title: Contract award types
awardTypes.description: USAspending contract type codes: A = BPA call, B = purchase order, C = delivery order, D = definitive contract. Default: all four.

awardingAgencies.title: Awarding agencies (top tier)
awardingAgencies.description: Exact USAspending top-tier agency names, e.g. "Department of Defense", "Department of Veterans Affairs".

awardingSubAgencies.title: Awarding sub-agencies
awardingSubAgencies.description: Exact USAspending sub-tier agency names, e.g. "Department of the Army", "Defense Information Systems Agency".

placeOfPerformanceStates.title: Place of performance states
placeOfPerformanceStates.description: Two-letter US state codes, e.g. VA, MD, DC.

setAsideTypes.title: Set-aside types
setAsideTypes.description: FPDS set-aside codes, e.g. SBA (small business), 8A, 8AN (8(a) sole source), HZC (HUBZone), SDVOSBC (service-disabled veteran), WOSB, EDWOSB, NONE.

minAwardValue.title: Min obligated amount (USD)
minAwardValue.description: Minimum total obligated amount of the award.

maxAwardValue.title: Max obligated amount (USD)
maxAwardValue.description: Maximum total obligated amount of the award.

minPotentialValue.title: Min potential value (USD)
minPotentialValue.description: Minimum base-and-all-options value. Applied after fetching award details.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of contracts to return. Each result is billed as one event.

includeDetails.title: Include award details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each award's detail record for potential end date, potential value, set-aside, contracting office and PIID. Slower but much richer.

onlyNew.title: Only new contracts (delta mode)
onlyNew.description: Skip contracts already returned by earlier runs with the same search settings. Ideal for scheduled weekly alerts.
